title: Adobe security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-250.121119: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – ADOBE SECURITY UPDATES
leadParagraph: Adobe has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple Adobe products. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.
contentHtml:
Adobe has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple Adobe products. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.

TTCSIRT strongly encourages users and administrators to review the following releases from Adobe and implement the necessary remediation actions:

APSB19-55: Adobe Acrobat and Reader
https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/acrobat/apsb19-55.html

 

APSB19-56: Adobe Photoshop CC
https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/photoshop/apsb19-56.html

 

APSB19-57: Brackets
https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/brackets/apsb19-57.html

 

APSB19-58: ColdFusion
https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/coldfusion/apsb19-58.html
